Category.Description: Category for the acquisition and trigger control features.

Category.Name: FunnyFeaturesControl

Category.Name: Scan3dControl
Category.ToolTip: Category for control of 3D camera specific features.
Category.Description: Category for control of 3D camera specific features.

Integer.Name: Width
Integer.ToolTip: Width of the image provided by the device (in pixels).
Integer.Description: Width of the image provided by the device (in pixels).

Integer.Name: Height
Integer.ToolTip: Height of the image provided by the device (in pixels).
Integer.Description: Height of the image provided by the device (in pixels).

Float.Name: AspectRatio
Float.Description: The only reason for this feature is to demonstrate support of floating point registers.

Enumeration.Name: ComponentSelector
Enumeration.ToolTip: Selects a component to activate/deactivate its data streaming.
Enumeration.Description: Selects a component to activate/deactivate its data streaming.

EnumEntry.Name: Intensity
EnumEntry.ToolTip: The acquisition of intensity (monochrome or color) of the visible reflected light is controlled.
EnumEntry.Description: The acquisition of intensity (monochrome or color) of the visible reflected light is controlled.

EnumEntry.Name: Range
EnumEntry.ToolTip: The acquisition of range (distance) data is controlled.
EnumEntry.Description: The acquisition of range (distance) data is controlled. The data produced may be only range (2.5D) or a point cloud giving the 3D coordinates depending on the Scan3dControl.

Boolean.Name: ComponentEnable
Boolean.ToolTip: Controls if the selected component streaming is active.
Boolean.Description: Controls if the selected component streaming is active.

Enumeration.Name: PixelFormat
Enumeration.ToolTip: Format of the pixels provided by the device.
Enumeration.Description: Format of the pixels provided by the device. It represents all the information provided by PixelSize, PixelColorFilter combined in a single feature.

Integer.Name: ComponentIDValue
Integer.ToolTip: Returns a unique identifier value that corresponds to type of the component selected by ComponentSelector.
Integer.Description: Returns a unique identifier value that corresponds to type of the component selected by ComponentSelector.

Integer.Name: PayloadSize
Integer.ToolTip: Provides the number of bytes transferred for each image or chunk on the stream channel.
Integer.Description: Provides the number of bytes transferred for each image or chunk on the stream channel. This includes any end-of-line, end-of-frame statistics or other stamp data. This is the total size of data payload for a data block.

Enumeration.Name: GenDCStreamingMode
Enumeration.ToolTip: Controls the device's streaming format.
Enumeration.Description: Controls the device's streaming format.

EnumEntry.Name: Off
EnumEntry.ToolTip: The device will only stream data in its native format.
EnumEntry.Description: The device will only stream data in its native format.

EnumEntry.Name: On
EnumEntry.ToolTip: The device will stream all its data in the generic GenDC format.
EnumEntry.Description: The device will stream all its data in the generic GenDC format.

Enumeration.Name: GenDCStreamingStatus
Enumeration.ToolTip: Returns whether the current device data streaming format is GenDC
Enumeration.Description: Returns whether the current device data streaming format is GenDC.

EnumEntry.Name: Off
EnumEntry.ToolTip: The device stream data in its native format.
EnumEntry.Description: The device stream data in its native format.

EnumEntry.Name: On
EnumEntry.ToolTip: The device stream all its data in the generic GenDC format.
EnumEntry.Description: The device stream all its data in the generic GenDC format.

Enumeration.Name: AcquisitionMode
Enumeration.ToolTip: Sets the acquisition mode of the device.
Enumeration.Description: Sets the acquisition mode of the device. It defines mainly the number of frames to capture during an acquisition and the way the acquisition stops.

EnumEntry.Name: Continuous
EnumEntry.ToolTip: Frames are captured continuously until stopped with the AcquisitionStop command.
EnumEntry.Description: Frames are captured continuously until stopped with the AcquisitionStop command.

Command.Name: AcquisitionStart
Command.ToolTip: Starts the Acquisition of the device.
Command.Description: Starts the Acquisition of the device. The number of frames captured is specified by AcquisitionMode.

Command.Name: AcquisitionStop
Command.ToolTip: Stops the Acquisition of the device at the end of the current Frame.
Command.Description: Stops the Acquisition of the device at the end of the current Frame. It is mainly used when AcquisitionMode is Continuous but can be used in any acquisition mode.

Float.Name: AcquisitionFrameRate
Float.ToolTip: Controls the acquisition rate (in Hertz) at which the frames are captured.
Float.Description: Controls the acquisition rate (in Hertz) at which the frames are captured.

Boolean.Name: ChunkModeActive
Boolean.ToolTip: Activates the inclusion of Chunk data in the payload of the image.
Boolean.Description: Activates the inclusion of Chunk data in the payload of the image.

Enumeration.Name: ChunkSelector
Enumeration.ToolTip: Selects which chunk to enable or control.
Enumeration.Description: Selects which chunk to enable or control.

EnumEntry.Name: Scan3dData
EnumEntry.ToolTip: Chunk carrying all the 3D data descriptions
EnumEntry.Description: Chunk carrying all the 3D data descriptions

Boolean.Name: ChunkEnable
Boolean.ToolTip: Enables the inclusion of the selected chunk data in the payload of the image.
Boolean.Description: Enables the inclusion of the selected chunk data in the payload of the image.

Integer.Name: ChunkNrBounces
Integer.ToolTip: Nr ball bounces since start of the game.
Integer.Description: Nr ball bounces since start of the game.

Enumeration.Name: ChunkComponentSelector
Enumeration.ToolTip: Selects the Component from which to retrieve data from.
Enumeration.Description: Selects the Component from which to retrieve data from.

EnumEntry.Name: Intensity
EnumEntry.ToolTip: The image data is the intensity component (visible).
EnumEntry.Description: The image data is the intensity component (visible).

EnumEntry.Name: Range
EnumEntry.ToolTip: The image data is the range component (distance or depth).
EnumEntry.Description: The image data is the range component (distance or depth).

Integer.Name: ChunkComponentIDValue
Integer.ToolTip: Returns a unique Identifier value that corresponds to the selected chunk Component.
Integer.Description: Returns a unique Identifier value that corresponds to the selected chunk Component.

Enumeration.Name: ChunkScan3dDistanceUnit
Enumeration.ToolTip: Returns the Distance Unit of the payload image.
Enumeration.Description: Returns the Distance Unit of the payload image.

EnumEntry.Name: Millimeter
EnumEntry.Description: Default value. Distance values are in millimeter units.

Enumeration.Name: ChunkScan3dOutputMode
Enumeration.ToolTip: Returns the Calibrated Mode of the payload image.
Enumeration.Description: Returns the Calibrated Mode of the payload image.

EnumEntry.Name: CalibratedABC_Grid
EnumEntry.Description: 3 Coordinates in grid organization. The full 3 coordinate data with the grid array organization from the sensor kept.

Enumeration.Name: ChunkScan3dCoordinateSystem
Enumeration.ToolTip: Returns the Coordinate System of the image included in the payload.
Enumeration.Description: Returns the Coordinate System of the image included in the payload.

Enumeration.Name: ChunkScan3dCoordinateSystemReference
Enumeration.ToolTip: Returns the Coordinate System Position of the image included in the payload.
Enumeration.Description: Returns the Coordinate System Position of the image included in the payload.

EnumEntry.Name: Anchor
EnumEntry.Description: Default value. Original fixed reference. The coordinate system fixed relative the camera reference point marker is used.

Enumeration.Name: ChunkScan3dCoordinateSelector
Enumeration.ToolTip: Selects which Coordinate to retrieve data from.
Enumeration.Description: Selects which Coordinate to retrieve data from.

Float.Name: ChunkScan3dCoordinateScale
Float.ToolTip: Returns the Scale for the selected coordinate axis of the image included in the payload.
Float.Description: Returns the Scale for the selected coordinate axis of the image included in the payload.

Float.Name: ChunkScan3dCoordinateOffset
Float.ToolTip: Returns the Offset for the selected coordinate axis of the image included in the payload.
Float.Description: Returns the Offset for the selected coordinate axis of the image included in the payload.

Boolean.Name: ChunkScan3dInvalidDataFlag
Boolean.ToolTip: Returns if a specific non-valid data flag is used in the data stream.
Boolean.Description: Returns if a specific non-valid data flag is used in the data stream.

Enumeration.Name: ChunkScan3dCoordinateReferenceSelector
Enumeration.ToolTip: Selector to read a coordinate system reference value defining the transform of a point from one system to the other.
Enumeration.Description: Selector to read a coordinate system reference value defining the transform of a point from one system to the other.

Float.Name: ChunkScan3dCoordinateReferenceValue
Float.ToolTip: Reads the value of a position or pose coordinate for the anchor or transformed coordinate systems relative to the reference point.
Float.Description: Reads the value of a position or pose coordinate for the anchor or transformed coordinate systems relative to the reference point.

Enumeration.Name: EventSelector
Enumeration.ToolTip: Selects which event to signal to the host application.
Enumeration.Description: Selects which event to signal to the host application.

EnumEntry.Name: GameProgress
EnumEntry.ToolTip: Event describing progress of the ping-pong game.
EnumEntry.Description: Event describing progress of the ping-pong game.

Enumeration.Name: EventNotification
Enumeration.ToolTip: Activate or deactivate the notification to the host application of the occurrence of the selected Event.
Enumeration.Description: Activate or deactivate the notification to the host application of the occurrence of the selected Event.

EnumEntry.Name: Off
EnumEntry.ToolTip: The selected event notification is disabled.
EnumEntry.Description: The selected event notification is disabled.

EnumEntry.Name: On
EnumEntry.ToolTip: The selected event notification is enabled.
EnumEntry.Description: The selected event notification is enabled.

Category.Name: EventGameProgressData
Category.ToolTip: Category that contains all the data features related to the Game Progress Event.
Category.Description: Category that contains all the data features related to the Game Progress Event.

Integer.Name: EventGameProgress
Integer.ToolTip: Returns the unique identifier of the Game Progress event type.
Integer.Description: Returns the unique identifier of the Game Progress event type.

String.Name: EventGameProgressMessage
String.ToolTip: Asynchronous messages about the game progress.
String.Description: Asynchronous messages about the game progress.

Command.Name: FancyBallOperation
Command.ToolTip: Switches the ball temporarily to a very fancy look.
Command.Description: Switches the ball temporarily to a very fancy look. Intended to demonstrate non-instant commands.

Enumeration.Name: Scan3dDistanceUnit
Enumeration.ToolTip: Specifies the unit used when delivering (calibrated) distance data.
Enumeration.Description: Specifies the unit used when delivering (calibrated) distance data.

EnumEntry.Name: Millimeter
EnumEntry.ToolTip: Distance values are in millimeter units (default).
EnumEntry.Description: Distance values are in millimeter units (default).

Enumeration.Name: Scan3dCoordinateSystem
Enumeration.ToolTip: Specifies the Coordinate system to use for the device.
Enumeration.Description: Specifies the Coordinate system to use for the device.

Enumeration.Name: Scan3dOutputMode
Enumeration.ToolTip: Controls the Calibration and data organization of the device and the coordinates transmitted.
Enumeration.Description: Controls the Calibration and data organization of the device and the coordinates transmitted.

EnumEntry.Name: CalibratedABC_Grid
EnumEntry.Description: 3 Coordinates in grid organization. The full 3 coordinate data with the grid array organization from the sensor kept.

Enumeration.Name: Scan3dCoordinateSystemReference
Enumeration.ToolTip: Defines coordinate system reference location.
Enumeration.Description: Defines coordinate system reference location.

EnumEntry.Name: Anchor
EnumEntry.Description: Default value. Original fixed reference. The coordinate system fixed relative the camera reference point marker is used.

Enumeration.Name: Scan3dCoordinateSelector
Enumeration.ToolTip: Selects the individual coordinates in the vectors for 3D information/transformation.
Enumeration.Description: Selects the individual coordinates in the vectors for 3D information/transformation.

Float.Name: Scan3dCoordinateScale
Float.ToolTip: Scale factor when transforming a pixel from relative coordinates to world coordinates.
Float.Description: Scale factor when transforming a pixel from relative coordinates to world coordinates.

Float.Name: Scan3dCoordinateOffset
Float.ToolTip: Offset when transforming a pixel from relative coordinates to world coordinates.
Float.Description: Offset when transforming a pixel from relative coordinates to world coordinates.

Boolean.Name: Scan3dInvalidDataFlag
Boolean.ToolTip: Enables the definition of a non-valid flag value in the data stream.
Boolean.Description: Enables the definition of a non-valid flag value in the data stream. Note that the confidence output is an alternate recommended way to identify non-valid pixels. Using a Scan3dInvalidDataValue may give processing penalties due to special handling.

Enumeration.Name: Scan3dCoordinateReferenceSelector
Enumeration.ToolTip: Sets the index to read a coordinate system reference value defining the transform of a point from the current (Anchor or Transformed) system to the reference system.
Enumeration.Description: Sets the index to read a coordinate system reference value defining the transform of a point from the current (Anchor or Transformed) system to the reference system.

Float.Name: Scan3dCoordinateReferenceValue
Float.Description: Returns the reference value selected. Reads the value of a rotation or translation value for the current (Anchor or Transformed) coordinate system transformation to the Reference system.

Command.Name: DeviceFeaturePersistenceStart
Command.ToolTip: Indicate to the device and GenICam XML to get ready for persisting of all streamable features.
Command.Description: Indicate to the device and GenICam XML to get ready for persisting of all streamable features.

Command.Name: DeviceFeaturePersistenceEnd
Command.ToolTip: Indicate to the device the end of feature persistence.
Command.Description: Indicate to the device the end of feature persistence.

Command.Name: DeviceRegistersStreamingStart
Command.ToolTip: Prepare the device for registers streaming without checking for consistency.
Command.Description: Prepare the device for registers streaming without checking for consistency.

Command.Name: DeviceRegistersStreamingEnd
Command.ToolTip: Announce the end of registers streaming.
Command.Description: Announce the end of registers streaming. This will do a register set validation for consistency and activate it.

Register.Name: GenDCFlowMappingTable
Register.ToolTip: Returns the GenDC Container data Flow mapping table that will be used to transport the GenDC Container.
Register.Description: Returns the GenDC Container data Flow mapping table that will be used to transport the GenDC Container.

Register.Name: GenDCDescriptor
Register.ToolTip: Returns a prefetch GenDC Descriptor that can be used as reference for the data to be streamed out by the device in its current configuration.
Register.Description: Returns a prefetch GenDC Descriptor that can be used as reference for the data to be streamed out by the device in its current configuration. This information can be used to set up the receiver in advance to be ready for the data Containers to come.

Port.Name: GameChunkPort
Port.ToolTip: Port for game related chunk features.
Port.Description: Port for game related chunk features.
